title: Protesters break into Microsoft data center site in Amsterdam
caption: Approximately 100 protesters breached a Microsoft data center construction site in Amsterdam, scaling cranes and unfurling banners.

title: Top Democrats call to rein in AI buildout after midterms sweep: 'National data center moratorium now'
caption: Democrats are calling for a national data center moratorium after midterm victories, citing voter opposition.

title: Researchers asked people to use AI chatbots for election info – results were mixed

title: Binance co-CEO Richard Teng says hackers used fake job interviews, AI tool to steal $6.3 billion in crypto

title: CrowdStrike's new kill switch can stop rogue AI agents in their tracks, CEO says
